Directions: Use the information about seesaws and your knowledge of science to answer each question that follows.
Title: Seesaws
Content: Students make a model seesaw. They balance a ruler on a triangular wood block. They use the model to learn about forces on a seesaw.
In Experiment `1`, the students find `text(two)` toy cars with the same mass. They put a toy car on `text(each end)` of the ruler. They then move the cars on the ruler until the ruler is flat.
In Experiment `2`, the students use rubber bands to hold both cars in place on the ruler. `text(One)` of the students pushes down on car `X` and then lets go. The students watch how the ruler moves.
In Experiment `3`, the students remove the rubber bands that hold the cars in place on the ruler. They then put a wood block on car `W`. They use a rubber band to keep the block in place on the car.
During the experiment, the students move the cars on the ruler until the ruler is flat.
